summary: Depth sweep (DEPTH=6 and DEPTH=10 vs baseline DEPTH=8) both hurt val_bpb (1.04 and 1.00 respectively), confirming baseline depth is near-optimal for the 5-minute budget. The real win came from halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2^19 to 2^18 (more, noisier optimizer steps per wall-clock second), which took val_bpb from 0.997333 to 0.988582 -- the single largest gain of my sweep. Pushing batch size down further to 2^17 overshot into too-noisy territory (0.994878, still beats baseline but worse than 2^18). A shorter warmdown ratio (0.3 vs 0.5) at the 2^18 batch size also hurt slightly (0.991420). Bumping EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.8 on top of the best batch config gave 0.988312, statistically indistinguishable from the plain 2^18 result. Next things worth trying: a finer batch-size grid between 2^18 and 2^19 (e.g. 2^18.5 via DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=96) to find the true optimum, and separately tuning MATRIX_LR/momentum-warmup schedule to match the higher step count now happening per run.
